title: David Defeats the Amalekites

questions.question: What happened to Ziklag while David was gone?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 30:1 (ESV): “...the Amalekites had made a raid... and had struck Ziklag and burned it with fire.”

questions.question: What was taken from Ziklag?
options: The women and all who were in it
questions.correctAnswer: The women and all who were in it
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 30:2 (ESV): “...and taken captive the women and all who were in it... they killed no one, but carried them off...”

questions.question: How did David’s men initially react?
options: They wept until they had no strength and spoke of stoning David
questions.correctAnswer: They wept until they had no strength and spoke of stoning David
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 30:4, 6 (ESV): “...wept until they had no more strength to weep. ...David was greatly distressed, for the people spoke of stoning him...”

questions.question: How did David find strength?
options: He strengthened himself in the Lord his God
questions.correctAnswer: He strengthened himself in the Lord his God
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 30:6 (ESV): “...But David strengthened himself in the Lord his God.”

questions.question: What principle did David establish regarding spoils?
options: He who goes down to battle and he who stays with the baggage share alike
questions.correctAnswer: He who goes down to battle and he who stays with the baggage share alike
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 30:24 (ESV): “...For as his share is who goes down into the battle, so shall his share be who stays by the baggage. They shall share alike.”

questions.question: Who led David to the Amalekite raiders?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 30:11 (ESV): "They found an Egyptian in the open country... he was the servant of an Amalekite."

questions.question: Why had the Egyptian been left behind?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 30:13 (ESV): "...my master left me because I fell sick three days ago."

questions.question: How many men stayed behind at the brook Besor?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 30:10 (ESV): "But David pursued, he and four hundred men. Two hundred stays behind, who were too exhausted..."

questions.question: When did David attack the Amalekites?
options: From twilight until the evening of the next day
questions.correctAnswer: From twilight until the evening of the next day
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 30:17 (ESV): "And David struck them down from twilight until the evening of the next day."

questions.question: How many Amalekites escaped?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 30:17 (ESV): "...except four hundred young men, who mounted camels and fled."

questions.question: What did David recover?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 30:18-19 (ESV): "David recovered all that the Amalekites had taken... nothing was missing..."

questions.question: What did the wicked men among David's followers want to do?
options: Give the exhausted men only their wives and children, but no spoil
questions.correctAnswer: Give the exhausted men only their wives and children, but no spoil
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 30:22 (ESV): "...‘Because they did not go with us, we will not give them any of the spoil... except every man's wife and children...’"

questions.question: David sent spoil to the elders of ______.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 30:26 (ESV): "...he sent some of the spoil to the elders of Judah..."

questions.question: What food did they give the Egyptian?
options: Bread, water, a piece of fig cake, and two clusters of raisins
questions.correctAnswer: Bread, water, a piece of fig cake, and two clusters of raisins
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 30:11-12 (ESV): "...gave him bread... water... a piece of a cake of figs and two clusters of raisins."

questions.question: Where was the spoil sent (one of the locations)?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 30:27-31 lists: Bethel, Ramoth of the Negeb, Jattir, Aroer, Siphmoth, Eshtemoa, Racal, cities of Jerahmeelites/Kenites, Hormah, Bor-ashan, Athach, Hebron.

key_verse_text: And David was greatly distressed... But David strengthened himself in the LORD his God. (ESV)
